# developerhub_applications (Data Source)

Lists Developer Hub applications ("GET APIMgmt.Applications" - see DESIGN.md §5/§7), for example to reference applications that are not managed by this Terraform configuration. SAP's collection read does not return application keys or secrets, so this data source cannot expose them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "developerhub_current_user" "me" {}

# All applications of the developer the provider authenticates as.
data "developerhub_applications" "mine" {
  developer_id = data.developerhub_current_user.me.name
}

output "application_titles" {
  value = [for a in data.developerhub_applications.mine.application : a.title]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `developer_id` (String) If set, only applications belonging to this developer id are returned.

### Read-Only

- `application` (Attributes List) The applications, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--application))
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier ("applications") for Terraform Plugin Framework data source convention.

<a id="nestedatt--application"></a>
### Nested Schema for `application`

Read-Only:

- `callback_url` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `developer_id` (String)
- `id` (String) The SAP-assigned application id.
- `title` (String)
- `version` (String)
